item.title: NEW: 🟠 Bitcoin Core discloses a bug that lets one peer freeze a node for more t…
item.description: NEW: 🟠 Bitcoin Core discloses a bug that lets one peer freeze a node for more than 12 seconds per malicious message. CVE-2026-117348 abuses the "orphanage": an attacker repeats one orphan transaction with thousands of missing parents, forcing the same costly check thousands of times. Project Loupe, an AI scanner built at Block's Spiral, found it in July. Versions 29.0 to 31.2 are affected. Fixes ship in 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1, and the 29.x branch gets no patch. If you run a node, update. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125204945230090465

item.description: NEW: 🟠 An AI security scanner finds a Bitcoin Core bug that lets one crafted message freeze a node for more than 12 seconds. Project Loupe, built by Elias Rohrer at Block's Spiral, shows that duplicate orphan announcements force a node to repeat the same expensive check thousands of times. The fix ships in Bitcoin Core 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1. The 29.x branch gets no patch, so anyone still running it needs to upgrade. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2124933365497241749
